description: Toll Transactions is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. Dataset contains counts of toll transactions collected by the MD Transportation Authority at its eight toll facilities. Coverage: Maryland. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are tolls, mdta, e-zpass, toll transactions, toll facilities. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: Maryland Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2020-07-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
